module_profile.scope: Synchronized module diagnostics; not an end-to-end latency benchmark
module_profile.timing_boundary: Synchronize before clock; call original function; synchronize before stopping clock
limitations: Synchronization serializes execution and adds host/device overhead
Inclusive times can overlap when wrapped boundaries are nested; do not sum them as end-to-end latency
Does not time policy preprocessing, action-mask/KV preparation or FM Euler updates outside these methods
Compile/capture costs are included if they occur; warm up before attaching and use a separate diagnostic run

workload.result_scope: one real LIBERO episode 0/frame 0 restored-eager request; partial operator arithmetic
workload.arithmetic_convention: One multiplication and one accumulation count as 2 FLOPs; called dense Linear/Conv modules and AdaLN functional conditioning projections only
not_counted: attention QK/AV matmuls and SDPA internals
GatedDeltaNet chunk/recurrent rule functional tensor operations
functional convolutions bypassing Conv module forward (including GDN decode)
ConvTranspose operations, including ActionCodec decoder upsampling
bias adds, activations, normalization, elementwise operations, reductions, RoPE and Euler updates
embedding/codebook lookups, data movement, preprocessing and backend padding/recomputation
workload.interpretation: Incomplete mathematical operator count, not total model FLOPs, measured hardware instructions, hardware utilization, or a compute-capacity requirement
workload.timing_scope: Hooks perturb execution. This request runs after formal timing and backend restoration; its latency is discarded and not added to benchmark samples or memory peaks.
workload.parameter_scope: Loaded policy and ActionCodec parameter roots, including inactive parameters; parameter presence does not imply an operator ran
